_comment: Runtime memory for the Evyasys session-start hook. Merged into every /Evya* command's context. Project-level memory in .evyasys/memory/ takes priority over this file.

team_glossary.requester: The person who initiates a business request
team_glossary.approver: The person who must confirm before the request proceeds
team_glossary.backlog: The prioritised list of stories ready for development
team_glossary.epic: A group of related stories delivering one business capability
team_glossary.DoR: Definition of Ready — gates a story into a sprint
team_glossary.DoD: Definition of Done — gates a story out of development
team_glossary.AC: Acceptance Criterion — a testable condition the story must satisfy
